gap._description: No confirmed rust emission gaps remain after the 2026-08-28 review: union_item and associated_type (previously emitting NOTHING) are now handled and fixture-pinned; differential ripgrep:rust is 0 missing / 0 unexplained at the pinned floor.

decisions.question: Rust has no class-based inheritance; trait supertraits and trait implementations are the hierarchy.
decisions.resolution: TRAIT SEMANTICS: trait supertrait bounds (trait Foo: Bar + Baz) emit extends; impl<Trait> for Type emits implements from the TYPE to the TRAIT. No overrides edge exists by design (no method shadowing across impls).

decisions.question: macro_rules! bodies parse as opaque token trees (token_tree/token_repetition/metavariable); expansion is not performed.
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: macro invocations emit a calls edge to the macro NAME (format! -> format), never expanded bodies; macro_definition emits a Macro symbol. Expansions are out of scope for a static analyzer.

decisions.question: Rust completeness scope is tied to the pinned tree-sitter-rust grammar.
decisions.resolution: The inventory is exhaustive for the pinned grammar; future grammar drift requires a new inventory review.

decisions.question: RSD1 (cargo+ripgrep census, 2026-09-05): qualified_calls were accumulated in a map keyed by BARE method name, so same-named methods on different types (Alpha.run / Beta.run; 21 deserialize methods in one file) shared one union payload — 410 buckets / 1,313 symbols / 749 excess entries.
decisions.resolution: Payloads attach DIRECTLY to the enclosing fn/method symbol at call time (java/groovy/cpp family contract). Payload now equals exactly the symbol's own call set; cross-type pollution structurally impossible. Pinned by rust/qualified-calls-ownership (per-owner notIncludes).

decisions.question: RSD2: the attach guard `!ctx.metadata.errors` wiped qualified_calls from EVERY function in any file with a parse error — 519 error files / 4,620 functions silently lost payloads (cargo's own frontmatter.rs: 40 fns from 18 single-token str![[r# raw-string grammar limits).
decisions.resolution: Whole-file suppression removed; per-symbol direct attach is precise under ERROR recovery (recovered code keeps the real enclosing symbol). Error files keep their functions' payloads. Pinned by rust/error-file-payload (fixture with a deliberate error).

decisions.question: RSD3: `struct Foo` + every `impl Foo` block created a symbol named Foo with the SAME id 'Foo' (also field vs same-named accessor) — 2,852 duplicate ids across 271 files. Id-keyed graph consumers dedupe silently, dropping distinct declarations.
decisions.resolution: Per-file usedIds set in createSymbol: first claim keeps the plain id, later same-(owner,name) declarations get deterministic '#N' suffixes (Alpha, Alpha#2, Alpha#3). Ids are in-memory only (not persisted); ownerName stays the type anchor for graph edges. Pinned by rust/qualified-calls-ownership expectUniqueIds + id pins.

decisions.question: RSD4: macro invocations emit calls edges (toSymbol macro:name) but never reached qualified_calls — a function whose body only invokes macros (format!/println!) had an empty payload despite real call sites.
decisions.resolution: Macro invocations attach `macro:name` payload entries (same vocabulary as their toSymbol), so payload == emitted call set per function. Pinned by rust/qualified-calls-ownership (second / macro:format).

decisions.question: RSD5 (cargo census, 2026-09-05): `self.x = v` (assignment_expression) and `self.x += v` (compound_assignment_expr) field expressions on the LEFT are WRITES, but the field_expression branch emitted uses unconditionally — 1,076 bogus edges across cargo+ripgrep. The oracle derives no uses truth, so no differential could catch it (cpp/ruby waves fixed the same class; rust never got the gate).
decisions.resolution: Span-compare gate (fresh-wrapper safe): a field_expression that is namedChild(0) of assignment_expression/compound_assignment_expr emits nothing; read-modify-write keeps its edge via the RHS occurrence. Pure reads unchanged. Pinned by rust/qualified-calls-ownership forbidRelationships (set_name/bump_count).

decisions.question: RSD6a (2026-09-05): `use std::{env, io, path::{Path, PathBuf}}` binds Path/PathBuf, but the inner scoped_use_list child fell through collect() and its leaves were silently DROPPED — 65 declarations across cargo+ripgrep (7,367 use-decls audited).
decisions.resolution: The use_list collector now recurses into nested scoped_use_list children and appends their leaf bindings (the submodule name is never bound unless listed). Pinned by rust/use-list-imports (module std, items env/io/Path/PathBuf).

decisions.question: RSD6b (2026-09-05): `use {std::sync::Arc, std::time::Duration};` has no shared module prefix, but the single-row aggregation fabricated module 'Arc, Duration' (items joined) — 28 declarations across cargo+ripgrep.
decisions.resolution: Top-level group imports now emit ONE import row per binding, each with its full module path (std::sync::Arc / std::time::Duration). Same-prefix rows still merge into one. Pinned by rust/use-list-imports per-binding rows + forbidImports 'Read, File'.
